kubectl describe pod -n dojo-docker-entrypoint -l app=web — look at the Command and Args fields in the container spec
A pod that exits with code 0 means the process completed successfully — /bin/sh with no arguments or script just starts and exits

Remove the command: and args: overrides from the container spec: kubectl patch deployment web -n dojo-docker-entrypoint --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/command"},{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args"}]'
